_doc: ALMA Science Archive metadata harvested 2026-09-11 for every execution block searched here. obscore (ivoa.obscore, asdm_uid) gives the antenna array and synthesised beam; the datalink service gives the raw ASDM progenitors of each member OUS, which obscore does not expose. frequency_support carries the archive-reported effective spectral resolution, i.e. the online Hanning/averaging state.
